output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.discount_pct > 0 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_share_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This query works out what percent of 2025 revenue came from order lines that had a discount. Following the warehouse rules, revenue only counts lines from completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in 2025. The query adds up the net amount of lines with a discount above 0%, divides it by the net amount of all those lines, and rounds the result to 2 decimals. Shipping fees aren't included because they don't count as revenue.
